title: File Island
closingQuote: "You think... this is the end? My master waits across the sea... the network..."
closingLine: The last Black Gear cracks apart. For the first time since you arrived, nothing falls from the sky.

reward.name: The Tags
reward.text: Empty Crest holders from Jijimon - somewhere across the sea, the Crests are waiting to fill them.

next.title: The Server Continent
next.teaser: Whamon waits at the shore. Across the sea, Etemon's network hums - and the Crests are hidden somewhere in it.
